name: volta-simulation-harness
description: Public, reusable engine for evidence-led Volta student simulations.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/authoring packages/service-auth packages/truth-engine packages/provisioning packages/student-cli packages/staff-dashboard
scripts.case:validate: npm run build --silent && node packages/authoring/dist/cli.js validate
scripts.clean: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/authoring packages/service-auth packages/truth-engine packages/provisioning packages/student-cli packages/staff-dashboard --clean
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/authoring packages/service-auth packages/truth-engine packages/provisioning packages/student-cli packages/staff-dashboard && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
